purpose: Distinguish trap-record nondetections from independent repeated occupancy surveys and independently measured A/B/M. Create strict ingest gate for new external field data, not a synthetic positive result.

field_schema.site_id: stable location identifier, reused across visits
field_schema.A_B_M: finite numeric proxies, independent measurement methods explicitly recorded, no automatic causal interpretation
field_schema.repeats: at least two distinct visit_id per site for minimum repeated-detection design
field_schema.season: visits per site within one prespecified closure window, here <=30 days
field_schema.effort: do not infer equal effort from presence of records

gate: FAIL_CLOSED for missing columns, duplicate site/visit, invalid detection, no repeats, bad effort, invalid coords, closure violation or missing A/B/M methods
interpretation: PASS means schema/replication readiness only; no validation of independence, true closure, detection calibration, spatial sampling representativeness, biological causal A/B/M or field ecological result.
